reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "OperatorHub Packages Discontinued: We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Environments using OperatorHub or Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM) to deploy or update cert-manager can no longer obtain versions beyond v1.16.5 from those sources; updates must switch to alternative distribution methods.
consequence.remediation: Switch to alternative cert-manager installation methods (Helm, direct manifests, or cloud-provider distributions) for versions after v1.16.5.

proposed.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes packages to OperatorHub, with v1.16.5 being the last release available on OperatorHub and the cert-manager-olm repository archived.
